fix(Wikipedia/SurjunctiveGroup): `gottschalk_surjunctivity_conjecture` is false (#7440)

Gottschalk's surjunctivity conjecture is false: two preprints of the
OpenAI math release (github.com/openai/math, commit adc7f124) construct
a group that is not surjunctive. This restates the declaration as
suggested in #6919.

**What changed** (one file,
`FormalConjectures/Wikipedia/SurjunctiveGroup.lean`)

- `gottschalk_surjunctivity_conjecture` is restated as `¬ ∀ (G : Type)
[Group G], IsSurjunctive G` and goes from `research open` to `research
solved`.
- New `counter_gottschalk_surjunctivity : ∃ (G : Type) (_ : Group G), ¬
IsSurjunctive G`, also `research solved`.
- Both carry `formal_proof using lean4`, pointing to
[`OAI.OddKaplansky.main_theorem`](https://github.com/openai/math/blob/adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a/lean/OAI/Algebra/OddKaplansky/Main.lean#L81).
- The module docstring cites the two preprints, with the URLs given in
the issue.

**Reviewer notes**

- The link differs from the repository statement by a transport that is
not in the linked proof. `main_theorem` proves that the linear automaton
`cellular b` over a finite field is injective and not surjective, as a
plain map. `IsSurjunctive` also asks for continuity and
shift-equivariance. That step is the short bridge in [my comment on
#6919](https://github.com/google-deepmind/formal-conjectures/issues/6919#issuecomment-6056115862);
it is not in this repository. The `OddKaplansky` directory of the
release has no occurrence of `Continuous` or `TopologicalSpace`; it
proves a finite local rule (`Cellular.IsCellular`), outside `MainClaim`.
The docstring of `counter_gottschalk_surjunctivity` states the gap. I
will drop the link if you prefer none here, as for the Sidorenko graphon
form in #6898.
- The linked theorem gives a finitely generated group. The finitely
presented group is in the characteristic-two preprint. The release's
Lean statements for that preprint (`KaplanskyDirectFiniteness` and
`KaplanskyFinitelyPresented` in `lean/ComparatorChallenges`) have no
automaton clause. I did not add a finitely generated or finitely
presented variant.
- The docstrings follow the abstract, Theorem 1.1 and Corollary 7.3 of
the characteristic-two preprint, and the abstract, Theorem 1.1 and
Section 8 of the odd-characteristic preprint. The proofs in the
preprints were not read.
- On 2026-10-10 the Wikipedia article cited by the file (last revised
2023-11-13) still described the question as open.

**Checks**

- `lake --wfail build FormalConjectures.Wikipedia.SurjunctiveGroup`
passes with Lean 4.33.1, on this branch rebased onto `main` at e754a78
(2026-10-18). No other module imports this file.
- The link resolves to `theorem main_theorem : MainClaim` at the pinned
commit (source inspection).
- The linked statement implies both repository statements. A scratch
file, not part of this PR, compiles in Lean 4.33.1 against the modified
module: it copies `MainClaim` verbatim from
`lean/ComparatorChallenges/OddKaplansky.lean`, takes it as a hypothesis,
and derives both statements. `#print axioms` reports `propext`,
`Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`. I can post the file.
- Reported in #6919 and not rerun for this PR:
`OAI.Algebra.OddKaplansky.Main` and its import closure build at
`openai/math@adc7f124` with Lean 4.34.1, and the bridge compiles on top
of them with the same three axioms.

Not done: a full `lake build` of the repository, `lake test`, Comparator
or any independent kernel replay of the release proof.

Closes #6919.

AI assistance: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5) drafted the restatement,
the docstrings and this description, and ran the checks above on my
machine; I reviewed and validated them.

+/-- **Gottschalk's surjunctivity conjecture** is false: there is a group that is not
+surjunctive.
+
+There are a finite field $K$, a group $G$ and $a, b \in K[G]$ with $ab = 1$ and
+$ba \neq 1$. The linear cellular automaton $x \mapsto (g \mapsto \sum_u b_u x(gu))$ on
+$K^G$ is then injective but not surjective. In [OAI26a], $K$ has characteristic two and $G$
+is finitely presented. In [OAI26b], $K$ has odd characteristic and $G$ is finitely
+generated.
+
+This was proved by an internal OpenAI model in September 2026. The linked Lean proof is for
+[OAI26b]. It shows that the map above is injective and not surjective. That the map is
+continuous and shift-equivariant, as `IsSurjunctive` requires, is not part of the linked
+proof. -/
